_note: Settings for scripts/build.py. Run the build after changing anything here.
_applicationUrl: HOME_LOAN_APPLICATION_URL. The online mortgage application link, once it is confirmed (full https:// address). Empty: every application button stays hidden on the site.
_images: Optional GHL Media links for assets/web/ (cbb-logo.webp, hero-house-sunset.webp, house-and-keys.webp, consultation.webp). Empty: the image is embedded in the block so it shows as soon as it's pasted. A link makes the block much smaller.
